# Prodeal Industries Ltd

> Ghana's premier B2B supplier for Industrial Chemicals, Waterproofing Systems, Construction Chemicals, Wholesale Disposable Bowls, 3D Signages, and Corporate Souvenirs.

## Overview
- **Legal Entity:** Prodeal Industries Ltd
- **Headquarters:** Accra, Greater Accra Region, Ghana
- **Service Area:** Accra, Tema, Kumasi, Takoradi, Tamale, and Nationwide Ghana / West Africa
- **Website:** https://www.prodealindustries.com
- **Ordering Channels:** Instant B2B RFQ Tray, Direct WhatsApp Dispatch, Official Corporate Quotations

## Core Divisions & Formulations

### 1. Industrial & Construction Chemicals
Prodeal Industries supplies industrial-grade waterproofing chemicals, concrete admixtures, architectural coatings, and damp-proofing systems designed for tropical climates in Ghana.
- **Roof Waterproofing:** Liquid elastomeric waterproofing membranes, polyurethane roof sealants, and acrylic coatings for concrete flat roofs and metal sheets.
- **Wall Seepage & Damp Proofing:** Crystalline damp-proof barriers, deep-penetrating silane water repellents, and anti-efflorescence wall sealants.
- **Concrete Admixtures:** Integral waterproofing admixtures, concrete hardeners, plasticizers, and structural bonding agents.
- **Exterior Protective Paints:** Weatherproof, UV-resistant, anti-fungal acrylic coatings for residential, commercial, and industrial facilities.
- **Solutions Directory:** https://www.prodealindustries.com/solutions

### 2. Disposable Food Packaging
- Bulk wholesale catering disposables, microwave-safe plastic bowls with leakproof lids, biodegradable bagasse containers, and kraft paper packaging.
- Directory: https://www.prodealindustries.com/divisions/bowls

### 3. 3D Signages & Architectural Branding
- Custom illuminated LED channel letters, 3D acrylic signs, ACP cladding, pylon signs, and municipal-permitted corporate signage.
- Directory: https://www.prodealindustries.com/divisions/signages

### 4. Corporate Souvenirs & Commercial Printing
- High-volume promotional gifts, branded corporate apparel, precision screen printing, laser engraving, and offset publishing.
- Directory: https://www.prodealindustries.com/divisions/printing
